parsed.title: Daily Task for AI Usage Credits
parsed.oneLiner: Play a 15-second mini-game with Luzia to earn daily AI usage credits.

newMechanic.name: Daily Tasks
newMechanic.description: A new interactive banner on the Chats Home screen offering daily mini-game challenges for AI usage credits.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Increases daily engagement and retention by gamifying the AI experience.

parsed.trigger: User taps the Daily Task banner on the Chats Home (s01) tab.
parsed.eligibility: Non-subscribers, once per day per user.

offer.title: Daily Task: Earn Credits
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second mini-game with Luzia to earn 5 extra AI usage credits.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Only offered to non-subscribers. The credits are additive to their quota and do not provide the advanced capabilities of the Luzia+ subscription. The banner is non-interruptive.
risks: High frequency of tasks could feel repetitive if not rotated.
Potential for users to rely on credits instead of subscribing.

newElements.change: Add a Daily Task banner element to provide a clear entry point for rewarded mini-games.

storyboard.caption: Users browse and start chats on the Home tab.
We add a new Daily Task banner for a rewarding mini-game.
Users opt-in to a 15-second game for 5 AI credits.
The user plays the mini-game with Luzia.
Upon completion, the user receives 5 AI usage credits.
